playstyle.identity: Renata Glasc is a manipulative enchanter whose ultimate makes enemies attack their own allies. She can also revive allies briefly after they would die.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q fires a missile that can be recast to throw the target. W buffs ally attack speed - if they would die, they get a zombie state and revive on takedown. E shields allies and damages enemies. R sends a wave that causes enemies to go berserk, attacking allies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Renata spikes at level 6 with her chaos ultimate. Enchanter items amplify her W saves. She's strong in teamfights with berserk turning fights.

strengths: W can save allies from death

passive.name: Leverage
passive.summary: Attacks mark enemies; ally attacks on marked targets deal bonus damage.
passive.details: Renata's attacks mark enemies. Allied champions who attack marked enemies deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Handshake
abilities.summary: Fire a missile; recast to throw the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Renata fires a missile that roots the first enemy hit. Recast to throw the enemy in a direction, damaging and stunning if they hit terrain or another enemy.

abilities.name: Bailout
abilities.summary: Buff an ally; if they would die, they become a zombie and revive on takedown.
abilities.details: Renata buffs an ally with attack speed and movement speed toward enemies. If they take lethal damage, they enter a zombie state and fully revive if they get a takedown before dying.

abilities.name: Loyalty Program
abilities.summary: Send missiles that shield allies and damage enemies passed.
abilities.details: Renata sends missiles outward that shield allies and damage enemies. The missiles converge at the target location.

abilities.name: Hostile Takeover
abilities.summary: Send a wave that makes enemies berserk, attacking their own allies.
abilities.details: Renata sends a chemical wave. Enemies hit become berserk, gaining attack speed but attacking anything nearby - prioritizing their own allies.
